title: Read a page for every model, matchup and effort step
summary: Each model now has its own page with scores and cost per task at every effort setting. Every two models that were current together get a head-to-head comparison, and each step up in effort, such as XHigh vs High, gets a page measured across models.

title: Count a model’s frontier settings in stars
summary: The Frontier badge is now a row of stars, one for each effort setting on the live cost frontier, so a model that leads at three budgets shows three stars.

title: Read effort curves in one table with distinct lab colors
summary: Inspect score, cost per task, and output tokens across every effort setting in a single table, with orange, blue, and green lab curves and live-frontier qualification.

title: Choose cookieless visits for the guide
summary: The blog’s privacy control lets you stop the guide from remembering visits on this browser.

title: A guide to reading the frontier
summary: Try a real cost-versus-score comparison inside Introducing aicharts, then open the explorer to compare releases for yourself.

title: Compare the effort settings behind a coding score
summary: Plot benchmark scores against dollars or output tokens per task. Compare a release with the models available on its launch day, or switch to the live field.

title: Take the release data with you
summary: The public JSON feed includes the source links, release dates, and effort-level measurements used in the explorer.
